stories.story_fr: Le CA atteint 3,0 Md$ au T3 FY2026, en hausse de 31% sur un an, une acceleration marquee par rapport aux +15-16% des trimestres precedents.
stories.story_en: Q3 FY2026 revenue reached $3.0B, up 31% YoY, a notable acceleration from the +15-16% growth seen in prior quarters.
stories.quote: Revenue of $3.0 billion for the third quarter of fiscal 2026, up 31% year over year

stories.story_fr: Le NGS ARR bondit de 60% a 8,1 Md$, indicateur cle de la dynamique SaaS et de la plateforme de securite nouvelle generation de PANW.
stories.story_en: NGS ARR surged 60% YoY to $8.1B, the key indicator of PANW's next-generation security subscription momentum.
stories.quote: Next-Generation Security ARR of $8.1 billion, up 60% year over year

stories.story_fr: Le RPO progresse de 36% a 18,4 Md$, offrant une forte visibilite sur les revenus futurs contractualises de PANW.
stories.story_en: RPO grew 36% to $18.4B, providing strong forward revenue visibility from committed customer contracts.
stories.quote: Remaining performance obligation of $18.4 billion, up 36% year over year

stories.story_fr: La marge FCF ajustee sur 12 mois glissants atteint 38,5%, en hausse de 430 points de base, sur la trajectoire de l'objectif 40% d'ici FY2028.
stories.story_en: Trailing 12-month adjusted FCF margin reached 38.5%, up 430 bps YoY, on track for the 40% FY2028 target.
stories.quote: Trailing 12-month adjusted free cash flow margin of 38.5%, up 430 basis points year over year

stories.story_fr: L'integration de CyberArk et Chronosphere contribue 388 M$ de CA et 1,6 Md$ de NGS ARR en un seul trimestre, en avance sur le plan.
stories.story_en: The CyberArk and Chronosphere integrations contributed $388M in revenue and $1.6B in NGS ARR in a single quarter, ahead of plan.
stories.signal: M&A: +388M$ CA, +1,6 Md$ NGS ARR en T3
stories.quote: Executing ahead of our M&A integration plans and improving profitability

stories.story_fr: Le CEO cite la frontiere IA comme catalyseur d'urgence en cybersecurite, PANW se positionnant comme partenaire de securisation des deploiements IA.
stories.story_en: CEO highlights the AI frontier as a catalyst for cybersecurity urgency, with PANW positioned to secure enterprise AI deployments at scale.
stories.signal: IA = catalyseur strategique cite par le CEO
stories.quote: AI frontier has increased the level of urgency around cybersecurity
